title: Hopeverse: Tamil Dance Number v2 (layered start, change every 8-18 s)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_global_styles: South Indian film dance number, street festival energy, composed like a film composer, not a DJ mix
kuthu groove: big live thappu and parai frame drums in a swung triplet feel, about 100 BPM
thavil pitched down as the bass, chopped and bent nadaswaram as the lead synth, ghatam and kanjira as glitchy top percussion
crowd chant of konnakol syllables as the hook, group 'hey' shouts
loud, clear, punchy mix with deep drums

positive_local_styles: ONLY one instrument: a bent nadaswaram synth alone plays a rising 3-note call: root, minor third, fifth, held and bent up
a lone parai frame drum joins under the nadaswaram synth, teasing the triplet swing
still no bass
the full kuthu band crashes in: thappu and parai triplet swing, pitched-down thavil bass, brass punches
crowd shouts hey
new texture: the crowd chants konnakol syllables on the swing
chopped nadaswaram riff answers each chant
ghatam and kanjira glitch fills
lines: ta ka dhi mi, ta ka jhu nu
ta ka dhi mi, ta ka jhu nu

positive_local_styles: bass and big drums step out, played by the band
only a kanjira and one konnakol voice remain
ends with one reversed veena swell into a huge unison hit
surprise change of gait: the rhythm switches from triplet swing to a straight four-beat dappu pattern
the main hook: crowd chant and brass in unison, bigger than everything before
lines: dhi mi dhi mi, ta ka ta!

positive_local_styles: the triplet swing returns
only drums and a konnakol voice trade phrases, speeding up
ends on a phrase played three times that lands exactly on beat one
lines: ta ka dhi mi ta, ta ka dhi mi ta, ta ka dhi mi ta

positive_local_styles: new top: strings join the counter-melody
highest energy triplet kuthu groove, brass, crowd chant, nadaswaram synth lead
louder than the first hook
lines: ta ka dhi mi, ta ka jhu nu, hey!

positive_local_styles: the 3-note call again on the nadaswaram synth over the drums
one big unison hit, then stop

brief.notes: v2 on rule 9.11 (Jithesh 29 Oct, refs R23-R24): one instrument alone, then two, then the full mix; a full section change every 8-18 s, with a played 3 s strip-down (bass and drums step out) before the big hook. Swing must return after the straight-four hook step.

story: A Tamil film dance number: the hero and the crowd take over the street festival.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
